name: Suzhou Nanomicro Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Suzhou Nanomicro Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and supply of spherical, mono-disperse particles for various industries and applications worldwide. Its products include chromatography media, solid phase extraction sorbents, particle size standards, magnetic particles, LCD spacers, ACF conductive particles, and various other micro particles. Its products portfolio also includes chromatography resins & pre-packed columns, LCD spacer and conductive particles, silica chromatography, microspheres for life sciences. The company also exports its products to the Americas, Asia, Europe, Africa, and other markets. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Suzhou, China.
